label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: CJ CUP Byron Nelson
items.text: Si Woo Kim leads at 18-under par after rounds of 64 and 60, five shots ahead of six players tied at 13-under including Sungjae Im and Scottie Scheffler.

items.headline: Im’s Hole-in-One Shift
items.text: Sungjae Im made a hole-in-one on the par-3 7th and eagled the par-5 9th to reach 13-under and share the 36-hole lead at THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson.

items.headline: Biggest Bunker Debate
items.text: A photo of a giant sand area on r/golf sparked debate about whether it counts as a bunker or a waste area, affecting how players must play it.

items.headline: Higgo Caddie Takes Blame
items.text: Austin Gaugert said he was responsible for Garrick Higgo’s two-stroke PGA penalty that contributed to missing the cut, leading to a caddie change at the Byron Nelson.
